annotations.title: Get a starting point when stuck about work

description: For someone who doesn't know what to do next, feels stuck or lost about work, or wants help working out a direction, e.g. 'I feel lost in my career', 'I hate my job but don't know what else I'd do', 'help me figure out what to do with my life', 'I'm 35 and still don't know what I want', 'midlife career crisis', 'I just graduated and have no idea what to do'. Returns a link to OffLadder's four quick questions, plus one optional, with their starting world already picked, where OffLadder's coach suggests two directions and a first experiment. Worlds: build (I could build things), nature (I could work with nature), stories (I could tell stories), business (I could solve business problems), people (I could help people), systems (I could understand how things work).

hint.description: A few words about what they enjoy, used only to pick a world. Not stored.

world.description: The world that sounds closest to them, if clear.

name: start_my_reading

continue_url.description: The same link, as the suggested next step.

cta_label.description: A short label for that link.

start_url.description: OffLadder's short onboarding, with a starting world picked if one was clear.

world.description: The starting world picked, if any.
